_meta.purpose: Locked parameter database for the HEART composite-renormalization ACCURACY test. Unlike the generic Appendix C placeholders, every modulus, fraction, and trajectory point here is an INDEPENDENTLY MEASURED, PUBLISHED, cited value from the cardiac-mechanics literature. This is the [O] -> [L] upgrade Appendix C named: the absolute per-scale moduli are now measured, so an ACCURACY test (does the renormalization composite CONTAIN / TRACK the measured myocardium?) becomes possible. The engine reads ONLY this DB for physical inputs; it never reads the validation TARGET (the measured tissue trajectory) when computing a PREDICTION. That separation is the difference between a locked measured input [L] and a back-fit.

grades.[L]: locked: independently measured/published value or exact theorem, cited; legitimate input
grades.[V]: verified: an EXACT closed form / theorem / logical certainty evaluated here (precision, not a measurement match)
grades.[F]: fixed modelling choice (generic central value of a cited range, or a documented functional form); declared
grades.[O]: open: the specific co-registered measurement does not exist here; a generic value stands in and the residual is declared open

_meta.rule: MEASURED-AND-CITED or EXACT-THEOREM => legitimate. PER-TARGET-TUNED => forbidden. No modulus below was chosen to make the bracket land on the tissue value; each is an independent literature measurement.
_meta.the_test: The myocardium is a two-phase composite: a CELL phase (cardiomyocytes, modulus B_cell, fraction phi_cell) and an ECM/COLLAGEN phase (modulus B_ECM, fraction phi_ECM). The EXACT elastic-mixture bounds bracket the composite modulus. The accuracy questions: (1) does the bracket CONTAIN the measured myocardium modulus at the embryonic AND adult endpoints? (2) is pure cell-jamming (Appendix C, no ECM) INSUFFICIENT to reach the adult tissue modulus from the soft embryonic cell -- forcing the ECM phase? (3) is the developmental stiffening trajectory therefore a COMPOSITION flow (collagen), orthogonal to the sequence material gamma -- explaining the Appendix A null?

tissue_stiffness_trajectory._axis: THE VALIDATION TARGET -- the MEASURED developmental stiffening of myocardium. The engine NEVER reads this when computing a prediction (non-fit invariant, gate D7). It is compared to the prediction only in the explicit accuracy/containment checks.

chick_embryo_intercept_kpa.provenance: Embryonic chick heart elastic modulus starts ~0.1 kPa: Majkut, Idema, Swift, Krieger, Liu & Discher 2013, Curr. Biol. 23:2434-2439 ('Heart-specific stiffening in early embryos parallels matrix and myosin expression to optimize beating'); restated in Pesce et al. 2022.

chick_embryo_slope_kpa_per_day.provenance: Embryonic chick heart stiffness rises ~0.3 kPa per day (approximately LINEAR in developmental time): Majkut et al. 2013, Curr. Biol. 23:2434-2439. The daily rise parallels a small subset of proteins -- COLLAGEN plus cardiac excitation-contraction proteins (proteomics, same paper).

murine_E2_kpa.provenance: Murine heart at embryonic day E2 has modulus < 1 kPa (central placeholder 0.5): Majkut et al. 2013 (comparative study cited in Ward & Iskratsch 2020; Frontiers Cell Dev Biol 2021).

murine_E14_kpa.provenance: Murine heart stiffens ~10-fold from E2 to E14, reaching ~10 kPa -- a value also measured in neonate and adult myocardium: Majkut et al. 2013.

adult_rat_myocardium_central_kpa.provenance: Adult rat heart elastic modulus ~18 +/- 2 kPa: Berry et al. 2006. Bhana et al. report 11.9-46.2 kPa for adult rat myocardium and 4-11.4 kPa for neonatal rat myocardium.

adult_human_myocardium_range_kpa.provenance: Normal adult human heart tissue stiffness ~10-50 kPa: Berry et al. 2006; Engler et al.; Bhana et al. 2010. The 10-30 kPa band is also the substrate elasticity on which cardiomyocytes form organized sarcomeres (Jacot/McCain; doc PMC3386849, PMC22196970).

cell_phase._axis: THE CELL PHASE -- single cardiomyocyte modulus, MEASURED. This is the B_cell input to the composite. Embryonic/immature cells are SOFT; adult cells are STIFF. The key falsification uses the EMBRYONIC cell modulus.

single_cardiomyocyte_immature_kpa.provenance: Human iPSC-derived (immature) cardiomyocyte Young's modulus ~1.25 kPa, decreasing on F-actin depolymerization: Pires et al. 2019 (cited in Frontiers Cell Dev Biol 2021). Representative of the soft EMBRYONIC/immature cell phase.

single_cardiomyocyte_adult_kpa.provenance: Adult rat freshly-isolated cardiomyocyte transverse/radial apparent elastic modulus ~35 kPa (35.1 +/- 0.7 kPa, n=53, F344xBN; Rutgers/Shroff-type AFM nanoindentation; also ~35 kPa diastolic, similar to skinned cardiomyocytes). Representative of the stiff ADULT cell phase.

cardiomyocyte_density_kg_per_m3.provenance: Myocardial / muscle mass density ~1.06 g/mL: standard cardiac tissue value. Used only as the density anchor for the VP wave-speed relation c^2=B/rho; the dimensionless results do not depend on it.

ecm_phase._axis: THE ECM / COLLAGEN PHASE -- the STIFF phase the pure-cell-jamming model (Appendix C) was missing. Modulus MEASURED on DECELLULARIZED myocardium (cells removed, ECM alone) and on reconstituted collagen networks. This is B_ECM. The whole discovery is that THIS phase, deposited over development, drives the stiffening.

decellularized_LV_ECM_kpa.provenance: Decellularized porcine LEFT-VENTRICLE myocardial ECM elastic modulus ~5 kPa: Williams et al. (cited in AJP-Heart 2024, doi 10.1152/ajpheart.00813.2024). The ECM phase modulus IN SITU with cells removed.

decellularized_SAN_ECM_kpa.provenance: Decellularized porcine SINOATRIAL-NODE myocardial ECM ~17 kPa (stiffer than LV): same source. Shows the ECM phase modulus spans ~5-17 kPa across heart regions.

collagen_I_network_range_kpa.provenance: Reconstituted type-I collagen network elastic modulus: a POWER LAW in concentration, ranging ~1 to several hundred kPa over 10-200 mg/mL (Col-I review, bioRxiv 2025.03.10.642521); compressed collagen scaffolds 2-10 kPa (Serpooshan/Ruel, PMC3809823); collagen-fibrin gels 0.5-3.7 kPa spanning native rat myocardium 2.67 kPa (PMC ACS 2018). Central working band 2-50 kPa.

ecm_phase_central_kpa.provenance: [F] A single central value for the ECM phase modulus, taken as the decellularized-myocardium central (~5-17 kPa -> 8 kPa working central). Used for the bracket; the measured RANGE is carried so the bracket can be reported as a range, not a point.

composition._axis: THE VOLUME FRACTIONS and the COLLAGEN TRAJECTORY -- how much of the myocardium is cell vs ECM, and how the ECM (collagen) fraction RISES over development. The trajectory SHAPE is measured-grounded (collagen rises faster than heart weight); exact co-registered fractions are [F]/[O].

cardiomyocyte_volume_fraction_adult.provenance: [F] Cardiomyocytes occupy ~70-90% of adult myocardial VOLUME (though <50% by cell NUMBER): standard cardiac histology (Vliegen; Banerjee). Central 0.80. Used as phi_cell; phi_ECM = 1 - phi_cell.

collagen_rises_faster_than_heart_weight.provenance: In the chick embryo, heart growth and collagen growth (day 5-21) both follow continuous EXPONENTIAL functions, but collagen increases MORE RAPIDLY than heart weight, so the collagen FRACTION rises over development: classic chick collagen-development study (Biochim. Biophys. Acta 1967, 0005-2795(67)90473-4). Mechanical interpretation given: rising collagen proportion meets the enlarging heart's increasing mechanical-strength requirement.

neonatal_high_collagen_protein_ratio.provenance: Neonatal/young human heart has a relatively HIGH total-collagen/total-protein ratio and a high type-I/type-III ratio (type I = rigidity, type III = elasticity), explaining a rigid, less-compliant state; both ratios gradually decrease to adult levels (collagen/protein normal by ~5 months): Marijianowski, van der Loos, Mohrschladt & Becker 1994, J. Am. Coll. Cardiol. 23:1204-1208 (hydroxyproline assay + Sirius red).

collagen_fraction_embryonic_start.provenance: [F] Collagen first detected in chick heart at day 3 and is sparse early (a few percent of volume); central 0.02 used as the embryonic ECM volume fraction start. Real co-registered value is [O].

gamma_axis_control._axis: THE NEGATIVE CONTROL -- the sequence material gamma. gamma is SEQUENCE-FIXED (the genome does not change over development), hence TIME-INVARIANT. The Appendix A result is reproduced here as the measured null: gamma is orthogonal to developmental timing, SHARPEST IN THE HEART.

gamma_is_time_invariant_over_development.provenance: [V] Logical certainty: gamma is computed from the genomic sequence (mean nearest-neighbour stacking dG), which is identical in every cell at every developmental stage. A time-invariant quantity cannot encode a time-varying trajectory. This is WHY gamma fails to predict the stiffening.

appendix_a_heart_timing_null_rho.provenance: Appendix A (universal_morphogenesis_geneclock): gamma vs absolute developmental timing is an honest NULL, sharpest in the heart, Spearman rho = +0.071. Reproduced here as the measured null the composition axis explains.

appendix_a_heart_timing_null_p.provenance: Appendix A: exact permutation p = 0.882 for the heart gamma-vs-timing null (not significant). The trajectory is NOT in gamma.

jamming_inherited._axis: INHERITED from Appendix C (hierarchy.jamming) -- the rigidity-emergence universals. Carried so the heart package is self-contained; identical values, same citations.

phi_c_3d.provenance: Jamming onset / random close packing phi_c ~ 0.639 (3D frictionless): O'Hern, Silbert, Liu & Nagel 2003, PRE 68:011306. Used for the pure-cell-jamming sub-model (the model being falsified for the trajectory).

rigidity_onset_exponent.provenance: Continuous rigidity onset ~ (phi-phi_c)^(1/2): O'Hern 2003 (Delta_z ~ (phi-phi_c)^1/2) composed with Wyart-Nagel-Witten 2005 (G ~ Delta_z). Inherited from Appendix C.

_open._axis: [O] data-blocked specifics -- declared open; what would CLOSE the accuracy claim
_open.co_registered_developmental_series: [O] a SINGLE co-registered developmental time series in ONE preparation giving, at each stage, (myocardium modulus E_tissue, collagen volume fraction phi_ECM, cell volume fraction phi_cell, single-cell modulus B_cell, ECM-phase modulus B_ECM). With it, the composite predicts E_tissue(t) with ZERO free parameters and the trajectory match becomes a tight [V]/accuracy test rather than a bracket-containment [L] consistency check.
_open.active_tension_contribution: [O] the ACTIVE (myosin contraction) contribution to apparent stiffness, separate from passive composite elasticity; Majkut shows contraction wave speed is LINEAR in E_t (active), distinct from the passive VP elastic wave c=sqrt(B/rho).
_open.strain_stiffening: [O] collagen and myocardium both show nonlinear STRAIN-STIFFENING; the linear-elastic bracket here is the small-strain modulus. Large-strain behaviour needs a measured stress-strain curve per stage.
